description: This file defines a class PolicyEntryCreatedStrategy that extends an abstract class AbstractPolicyEventStrategy. The class handles PolicyEntryCreated events by applying changes to a PolicyBuilder object.

classes.name: PolicyEntryCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles PolicyEntryCreated events by applying the event data to a PolicyBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process a PolicyEntryCreated event by setting the policy entry in the PolicyBuilder.
